name: Claire: A Tale of Monsters & Candy
source:
All Hallows Eve, a day when every child puts on their best costume to look for a very special prize: Candy. Legends say, the more, the better, however the true reward still remains unknown.

Embark on Claire’s first Halloween adventure and play trick or treat throughout the neighbourhoods, but remember that not everything is what it seems.

[From [url=https://artorres.itch.io/claire-a-tale-of-monsters-and-candy]itch.io[/url]]
